// diagnostic

E2521

Cannot compose `{first}` with `{second}`: `{middle_a}` does not match `{middle_b}`.

What

Cannot compose `{first}` with `{second}`: `{middle_a}` does not match `{middle_b}`.

Why

A transform chain is valid only when the destination of the first transform is the source of the next one.

Fix

Reverse or replace one transform so both middle spaces are the same.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2521: tests/ui/coordinate_transform_mismatch.stderr.

Error [E2521]: Cannot compose `Transform<Screen, World>` with `Transform<View, Camera>`: `World` does not match `View`.
  --> tests/ui/coordinate_transform_mismatch.jet:10:21
    |
 10 |     screen_to_world.then(view_to_camera)
    |                     ^^^^
 Why: A transform chain is valid only when the destination of the first transform is the source of the next one.
 Fix: Reverse or replace one transform so both middle spaces are the same.
